Ivy Chen: Hello hello! I'm Ivy (she/her), joined the Docs & DevEx team today. Big fan of matcha lattes, shortwave radio, and urban sketching. Excited to help improve our quickstarts and guides 
Rafael Ortiz: welcome ivy!! we have a sketchcrawl group that meets after lunch on Wednesdays. would love to have you join :paintbrush:
Mina Alvarez: matcha lobby meet? also pinging @onboarding-bot to set up your buddy intro call 
Eli Tran: hey ivy, welcome. shortwave radio is so cool. if you ever want to tinker with antennas we have an electronics corner in the mezzanine
Harper Lin: btw what are your lunch preferences? mexican/korean/salad? we usually do a rotating sign-up. 
Ivy Chen: thanks y'all! no dietary restrictions, huge fan of kimchi fries but salad sometimes. matcha lobby meet sounds lovely. 
Samir Goyal: welcome! FYI there's a tiny jar of wasabi-covered almonds in the snack cabinet. share at your own risk :grimacing:
Ivy Chen: LOL noted 
Rafael Ortiz: welcome again. posted a little welcome doodle on your desk :sparkles:
